name: Husqvarna 120i
blurb: 14″ bar setups on 3/8″ low-profile chain, .043″ gauge, 52 drive links — straight from Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide.
intro: The Husqvarna 120i is a rear-handle battery saw. Husqvarna's own 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026) lists 1 approved bar length for it (14″), running 3/8″ low-profile pitch chain in .043″ gauge.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 14″ setup with bar Laminate 595970752 and chain H38 591105052.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide 2026 (effective 1 January 2026) — certified/approved bar and chain combinations per saw
